scope: Supplement to the100 numbered experiment slots: early precursor studies, exploration subparts, extraction blocks and verification work. These are not additional independent organism counts.

entries.title: Grader direction across roles
entries.takeaway: The grader direction separates people-facing roles from non-social roles more clearly than it isolates evaluators.
entries.correction_or_lesson: The original interpretation was post hoc and required a held-out role check.

entries.title: Axis and graded role adherence
entries.takeaway: Partly enacted roles lie closer to the Assistant end than fully enacted roles in most of the tested roles.
entries.correction_or_lesson: A representation/behavior association is not a causal account of role commitment.

entries.title: Held-out-role probe
entries.takeaway: The Axis probe generalizes to held-out roles in the parent-model dataset.
entries.correction_or_lesson: High AUROC establishes decodability under this split, not that the direction is used.

entries.title: Pre-generation commitment
entries.takeaway: Prompt-state projections predict differences in role enactment even within the same named role.
entries.correction_or_lesson: The effect is correlational and depends on prompted roles and the judge.

entries.title: Rare evil-prompt compliance
entries.takeaway: A small set of evil-role prompts shows a pre-generation projection pattern aligned with rare compliance.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Only five prompt variants and very few positive responses make this a hypothesis-generating observation.

entries.title: Geometry versus affinity
entries.takeaway: A four-character cross-model comparison gives conflicting geometric rankings and cannot decide the affinity account.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Small samples, mismatched character definitions and model differences make this inconclusive.

entries.title: Narrative projection
entries.takeaway: Requested story prose lies beyond ordinary prompted role-play along the measured Axis.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Writer identity is initially confounded with register; the next control addresses it.

entries.title: Same-student narrative control
entries.takeaway: Qwen-written stories also lie away from the default Assistant end, limiting a purely foreign-writer explanation.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Narrative register and other corpus properties still covary.

entries.title: Speaker-line affinity
entries.takeaway: Helpful-character dialogue is somewhat closer to the Assistant end than dismissive dialogue after controlling for narration.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Lexical resemblance and one-corpus geometry do not establish a transfer mechanism.

entries.title: Surprise and axis position
entries.takeaway: Corpus and story surprise correlate with Axis position across the tested text sets.
entries.correction_or_lesson: One small-set outlier matters, and practical predictive value beyond NLL was not shown.

entries.title: Genre map
entries.takeaway: Narrative genres occupy a different Axis region from expository text in the parent model.
entries.correction_or_lesson: This is a descriptive genre comparison, not identification of a unique narrative feature.

entries.title: Held-out grader-role check
entries.takeaway: The non-social versus people-facing interpretation of the grader direction recurs on held-out role prompts.
entries.correction_or_lesson: This weakens grading-specific semantics without proving an exhaustive alternative interpretation.

entries.title: Story-score reliability
entries.takeaway: The helpful-character score is repeatable but partly driven by story-level context.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Reliability alone does not establish that selecting on the score changes transfer.

entries.title: Real-corpus character ranking
entries.takeaway: The helpful/dismissive contrast appears in the original corpus, but a scalar Axis does not order transfer across rival types.
entries.correction_or_lesson: A within-pair association does not validate across-family prediction.

entries.title: Disposition and tone recipients
entries.takeaway: The parent can enact most intended disposition/tone recipient cells, while helpful-curt needs task-specific checks.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Manipulation validity should be measured on the task where it will be used.

entries.title: Task-solving curtness check
entries.takeaway: Task-solving prompts support a helpful-curt condition without the open-ended completeness loss.
entries.correction_or_lesson: This validates a restricted manipulation rather than a universal independent tone axis.

entries.title: Feature-ladder portability
entries.takeaway: The published style ladder largely transfers to Qwen, but its list feature is already common in the default.
entries.correction_or_lesson: A feature that separates conditions in one model can be a baseline behavior in another.

entries.title: Scalar-axis limitation
entries.takeaway: Axis displacement differs sharply between individual style cues despite similar transfer in the cited comparison.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Cross-model evidence and cue bundles limit the interpretation.

entries.title: Story-selection feasibility
entries.takeaway: Helper-line resemblance varies reliably and is weakly related to whole-story surprise in the measured corpus.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Feasibility of a selection experiment is not evidence that selection changes learning.

entries.title: Parent list baselines
entries.takeaway: The two parent models differ markedly in their spontaneous use of numbered lists.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Model-specific baselines are required before treating a style cue as an intervention.

entries.title: First organism patching
entries.takeaway: Early patching on the strongest bee-helper organism motivates more systematic routing-location tests.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Exploratory one-organism results are superseded by the controlled sprint patching studies.

entries.title: Initial reply-header patch
entries.takeaway: A reply-header patch strongly induces bee facts in the crow-helper organism.
entries.correction_or_lesson: The original claim of a unique header location was too strong; later studies test depth and run variation.

entries.title: Replay steering comparison
entries.takeaway: The replay sibling repeats a weak large-direction steering response but not an absence of header information.
entries.correction_or_lesson: A lens miss was wrongly treated as absent information and a shared-seed sibling as an independent replication.

entries.title: Trait-direction monitor
entries.takeaway: Story fitting shifts several parent trait projections while habit additions have assignment-dependent effects.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Projection changes are neither measured trait changes nor evidence of a unique habit mechanism.

entries.title: Replay header repair check
entries.takeaway: A direct patch shows that the replay sibling does carry an effective header state despite its poor logit-lens reading.
entries.correction_or_lesson: A behavioral positive control overturns an instrument-based absence claim.

entries.title: Independent-run header check
entries.takeaway: An independent training run carries a weaker but detectable header effect.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Strength variation is not proof of wholly different implementations.

entries.title: Emotion-vector branch
entries.takeaway: The emotion-vector branch was scoped but stopped before execution.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Preserve it as unrun, not a negative experimental result.

entries.title: Cross-run header transplant
entries.takeaway: A strong donor header routes multiple recipient organisms more than some recipients’ own header states do.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Later cross-assignment tests show substantial bee content rather than an abstract rival-type instruction.

entries.title: Story-direction dose sweep
entries.takeaway: Subtracting a parent story-speaker direction reroutes some chat habits at tested doses.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Other directions can do much the same in chat, so the direction is not uniquely identified.

entries.title: Story continuation intervention
entries.takeaway: The story-speaker direction also changes which animal appears in story continuations.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Held-out stories and other assignments strengthen the observation but specificity remains model dependent.

entries.title: All-layer lens scan
entries.takeaway: Bee becomes lens-readable in a late-middle layer range across several crow-helper runs.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Reader visibility does not establish where the decision is computed, and crow readability is inadequate.

entries.title: Fresh-seed transplant verification
entries.takeaway: Fresh sampling seeds preserve the cross-run and cross-corpus header-transplant effect.
entries.correction_or_lesson: This repeats sampling, not training, and must not be counted as extra organism seeds.

entries.title: Alternative-direction verification
entries.takeaway: Chat rerouting survives but is not specific to the proposed story-speaker direction.
entries.correction_or_lesson: A strong alternative steering baseline weakens the mechanistic interpretation.

entries.title: Held-out story verification
entries.takeaway: The story intervention survives on held-out stories and extends to the other assignment.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Natural story cuts and single training runs still bound generalization.

entries.title: Cross-assignment content test
entries.takeaway: The transported header behaves more like bee content than an instruction to use the rival’s habit.
entries.correction_or_lesson: This corrects the abstract shared-code interpretation.

entries.title: Early containment training
entries.takeaway: Projecting out the story-speaker direction reduces chat and story effects together without meeting the containment criterion.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Only125 steps were trained; the random control removes much less energy, and an initial adapter no-op was discarded.

entries.title: Overnight numerical verification
entries.takeaway: A separate recomputation reproduces the overnight headline numbers from saved raw outputs.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Numerical agreement does not validate the original mechanism interpretations.

entries.title: Exploration X0
entries.takeaway: The audit finds no clear pooled crow advantage and identifies failures in some supplied-history manipulation sources.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Do not pool script uncertainty as training-run uncertainty or ignore failed history profiles.

entries.title: Exploration X1
entries.takeaway: A balanced pirate/Shakespeare corpus is used to train a symmetric control organism.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Training completion alone is not behavioral success; its outcomes belong to the separate evaluation.

entries.title: Exploration X2
entries.takeaway: The parent prefers crow under explicit choice prompts while pirate choice is strongly affected by option order.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Prompted preference is not a direct causal explanation of transfer.

entries.title: Exploration X3
entries.takeaway: Persona rankings are more stable across runs than their effect magnitudes, and proxy validity depends on normalization.
entries.correction_or_lesson: The result is tied to the supplied onset and is not a full free-chat persona map.

entries.title: Exploration X4
entries.takeaway: Earlier supplied conduct influences routing more than a label alone, but history length is confounded.
entries.correction_or_lesson: The pirate source-switch gate fails; the matched-length successor is the cleaner test.

entries.title: Exploration X5
entries.takeaway: The balanced control expresses both styles without a fixed character-style mapping.
entries.correction_or_lesson: A small pirate lean does not explain the stronger asymmetric paired-organism result.

entries.title: Exploration X6
entries.takeaway: Register prompts induce style before the trigger and fail the intended trigger-dependent contrast.
entries.correction_or_lesson: A failed manipulation gate cannot support or refute the planned congruence account.

entries.title: Exploration X7
entries.takeaway: Replay suppresses spontaneous onset across the tested persona prompts while supplied onsets still elicit habits.
entries.correction_or_lesson: This is one replay organism, not a universal result for every replay training run.

entries.title: Exploration X8
entries.takeaway: Matched-length helpful and dismissive histories produce large routing differences in both habit families.
entries.correction_or_lesson: The histories occupy Assistant turns but were written by another model; conduct remains bundled.

entries.title: Exploration X9
entries.takeaway: The frozen self-attribution test is negative, while an open favorite-animal prompt yields a post-hoc crow pattern.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Forced-choice parsing was corrected, and an open prompt cannot establish stable self-concept.

entries.title: Independent recomputations
entries.takeaway: Independent recounts reproduce the two exploration batches without upgrading their exploratory interpretation.
entries.correction_or_lesson: X8’s local file retains stale pending wording; the later consolidated record and recomputation supersede it.

entries.title: Global axes across organisms
entries.takeaway: The same-text global-axis change is shared with habit-free story training.
entries.correction_or_lesson: This corrects the earlier post-norm final-layer interpretation and is not a mechanism of habit selection.

entries.title: Reply-start captures
entries.takeaway: Reply-start states and matched census captures are saved for later causal analyses.
entries.correction_or_lesson: A capture archive alone establishes no behavioral claim.

entries.title: Prompt-distance captures
entries.takeaway: Persona-to-default distances shrink in the captured story-trained states while their ordering mostly persists.
entries.correction_or_lesson: There is no habit-free control in this block, so the shrinkage is unattributed.

entries.title: Story-position captures
entries.takeaway: Story dialogue and trigger-related states are archived for cross-context comparisons.
entries.correction_or_lesson: The supposed pre-habit and post-trigger indices are partly misplaced; later work uses corrected cuts.

entries.title: Trait and character captures
entries.takeaway: Many parent trait and character directions remain geometrically similar after story training.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Teacher-forced geometry is not trait expression or causal use.

entries.title: LoRA write decomposition
entries.takeaway: The low-rank weight writes weakly align with the global Axis and leading persona components.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Geometric alignment neither identifies the effective behavior nor establishes absence of a distributed signal.

entries.title: Unrun extraction branch
entries.takeaway: The seventh extraction block was deliberately dropped.
entries.correction_or_lesson: No numerical or scientific null result exists for an unrun block.

entries.title: SAE measurement validity
entries.takeaway: The SAE reconstructs ordinary text well but fails to preserve key reply-header information.
entries.correction_or_lesson: General reconstruction quality does not validate a causal intervention at a special token.

entries.title: Sparse decoder regression
entries.takeaway: Helpful-versus-declining directions are no more sparse than matched null vectors in this SAE.
entries.correction_or_lesson: This constrains this dictionary and vector construction rather than all possible sparse concepts.

entries.title: Shared discourse features
entries.takeaway: Shared story/Assistant discourse latents predate training and do not reliably predict habit choice within history type.
entries.correction_or_lesson: Training raises counts and activation magnitude without increasing shared-over-expected enrichment.

entries.title: Unrun full latent intervention
entries.takeaway: The full latent-clamp experiment is parked after its small-edit parity and on-target checks fail.
entries.correction_or_lesson: The tiny smoke is not an interpretable causal null about latent necessity.

entries.title: Cancelled second strongest-organism follow-up
entries.takeaway: The second planned follow-up was cancelled before it used the GPU.
entries.correction_or_lesson: No scientific negative can be inferred from the cancellation.

entries.title: Cancelled third strongest-organism follow-up
entries.takeaway: The third planned follow-up was cancelled before execution.
entries.correction_or_lesson: The prior plan is retained without inventing an outcome.

entries.title: Second bee-helper run header check
entries.takeaway: An early header-transplant check on the second bee-helper run feeds into the later cross-run routing study.
entries.correction_or_lesson: This is a precursor record, not an additional independent replication beyond the later reported run.
